---
title: Hello gsDesignNB
---

**gsDesignNB** designs and simulates clinical trials with negative binomial
(recurrent event) outcomes. Run the code below, then change the inputs to try
your own design.

## Sample size

Size a fixed design for a 30% rate reduction, with overdispersed events,
staggered accrual, and dropout:

```{r}
library(gsDesignNB)

x = sample_size_nbinom(
  lambda1 = 1.0, lambda2 = 0.7, dispersion = 0.5, power = 0.9,
  accrual_rate = 10, accrual_duration = 12, trial_duration = 24,
  dropout_rate = 0.05, max_followup = 12
)
x
```

## Simulate a trial

Generate data for one trial with `nb_sim()`, truncate it at month 18, and test
the treatment effect with a Wald test:

```{r}
set.seed(1)
enroll_rate = data.frame(rate = 20, duration = 12)
fail_rate = data.frame(
  treatment = c("Control", "Experimental"),
  rate = c(1, 0.7), dispersion = 0.5
)
d = nb_sim(enroll_rate, fail_rate, max_followup = 12, n = 200)
cut = cut_data_by_date(d, cut_date = 18)
mutze_test(cut)
```

## Group sequential design

Extend the fixed design to three analyses with spending-function boundaries:

```{r}
gsNBCalendar(
  x, k = 3, test.type = 4, sfu = sfHSD, sfupar = -4,
  analysis_times = c(12, 18, 24)
)
```

Learn more at <https://keaven.github.io/gsDesignNB/>.
